work.composition: central plane with disc constellation, target frieze base
work.description: Mixed-media collage incorporating three iridescent compact discs suspended over overlapping printed ephemera, including a technical warplane diagram, concentric target motifs, and photographic fragments. Orange vertical bands and red diagonal elements intersect a lower register of numbered columns and small figurative imagery against a predominantly pale ground.
work.title: Untitled (Iridescent Squadron)
